svg.title: Recommendations from Quentin Payré, Patrick Raguin and Marie Postic
svg.desc: “His strong technical expertise helped us make several crucial architecture decisions, combining rigour, pragmatism and a real ability to bring others along.” — Quentin Payré, Flutter developer · Renault Digital project. “As a senior Flutter/Dart developer, Jérémy brought a long-term vision to our projects, anticipating future needs and proposing suitable, scalable technical solutions.” — Patrick Raguin, Flutter / Fullstack Lead · SNCF Connect project. “Highly involved in the team, he stands out for his common sense and ability to challenge both technical and functional choices, always in service of the product and the user.” — Marie Postic, Product Owner.
